summary: Tested VIP Elite text color fix and FR translation fix on TrendySubscriptionCards. Found TWO CRITICAL ISSUES that need to be fixed by main agent.

ui_bugs.issue: VIP Elite title color is rgb(26, 26, 26) (dark) instead of rgb(255, 255, 255) (white). The inline style IS being applied (style='color: rgb(255, 255, 255);') but a CSS rule with !important is overriding it. The global rule at index.css line 1806-1808 'h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 { color: #1a1a1a !important; }' is overriding the VIP-specific rule.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking FR button does NOT change the language. localStorage 'bidvex_language' remains 'en' after clicking FR. The i18n.changeLanguage() function is not working or the language change event is not being fired. All text remains in English including navbar, TrendySubscriptionCards plan names, descriptions, and CTAs.

action_items: FIX VIP TITLE COLOR: The CSS specificity issue needs to be resolved. The global rule 'h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 { color: #1a1a1a !important; }' at line 1806-1808 in index.css is overriding the VIP-specific rule. Either remove the global !important or add a more specific selector for VIP title.

FIX LANGUAGE TOGGLE: The i18n.changeLanguage() function is not working. Debug why clicking FR button doesn't change localStorage 'bidvex_language' from 'en' to 'fr'. Check if the changeLanguage function in Navbar.js is being called and if i18n.changeLanguage() is executing properly.

VERIFY TRANSLATIONS: Once language toggle is fixed, verify that TrendySubscriptionCards shows French translations: VIP Elite → VIP Élite, Starter → Débutant, Ultimate auction experience → L'expérience d'enchères ultime
critical_code_review_comments: CSS Specificity Issue: The global rule 'h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 { color: #1a1a1a !important; }' is too broad and overrides inline styles. Consider removing !important from global rules or using more specific selectors.

i18n Integration: The language toggle button click is not triggering language change. The i18n.changeLanguage() call in Navbar.js line 41 may not be executing or the event listener in i18n.js line 59 may not be firing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two critical issues found: 1) VIP title color is dark instead of white due to CSS !important override, 2) Language toggle (EN/FR) is completely broken - clicking FR button doesn't change the language. The TrendySubscriptionCards component is at /settings → Subscription tab. The inline style for VIP title IS being applied but CSS is overriding it.

vip_color_issue.root_cause: CSS specificity conflict. Global rule 'h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 { color: #1a1a1a !important; }' at index.css line 1806-1808 overrides the inline style 'color: rgb(255, 255, 255)' because !important in CSS takes precedence over inline styles.
vip_color_issue.evidence: Debug output showed: inlineStyle='color: rgb(255, 255, 255);' but computed color='rgb(26, 26, 26)'
vip_color_issue.fix: Either remove !important from global h3 rule OR add !important to inline style OR use a more specific CSS selector for VIP title

language_toggle_issue.root_cause: Unknown - i18n.changeLanguage() is not executing or not triggering re-render
language_toggle_issue.evidence: localStorage 'bidvex_language' remains 'en' after clicking FR button. Navbar text remains in English.
language_toggle_issue.fix: Debug the changeLanguage function in Navbar.js and verify i18n.changeLanguage() is being called
